results.title: Keepers of Memory: Nature in the Age of Fire
results.original_title: Custodi della memoria. La Natura al tempo del Fuoco
results.overview: Focusing on the catastrophic wildfires in British Columbia, this documentary blends Indigenous wisdom, ambient nature soundscapes, and personal testimonies—including survivors of the 2021 Lytton disaster. The film highlights the deep spiritual connection between humanity and nature, calling for environmental stewardship while exposing the ongoing grief of Indigenous communities stripped of their ancestral lands.

results.title: White Lightning
results.overview: WHITE LIGHTNING is a gritty, funny, and uniquely American story about second chances, legacy, and what it takes to outrun your past. This feature-length documentary follows 18-year-old sprinter King Combest as he attempts to break his father’s 25-year-old national high school record–and the cycle of drugs, jail, and poverty that has shaped his Kentucky family for generations. King’s father Casey (aka “White Lightning”) was once an elite sprinter destined for Olympic greatness before a marijuana arrest derailed his career and left him working as a janitor on the margins of society. As King chases his father’s iconic record, it becomes clear that the real stakes are far greater: becoming the first man in the Combest family to earn a college degree and forging a path beyond a legacy of crime and addiction.

results.title: Onnopata
results.overview: After his father's death, Ratul, an engineering admission aspirant, struggles to make ends meet by working as a clown at various events. While copying his friend's coaching notes, he meets Tiha, sparking unexpected feelings as he navigates academic pressure and the societal challenges faced by engineering aspirants in Bangladesh.

results.title: Alpha Alice
results.overview: Alice cannot find an apartment in Munich for her psychology studies. Out of desperation, she accepts the offer of a man who wants to be treated as a slave by his roommate. In her private life, Alice is rather shy, but in her new role she learns to take control, not only over her roommate Olaf, but also over her own life. An unusual friendship develops between Alice and Olaf, giving them both the sense of security they have been looking for.

results.title: Not from here (Not from there)
results.original_title: No soy de aquí (Ni soy de allá)
results.overview: Young people from different parts of Chile share their experiences of moving to and living in the capital, Santiago, reflecting on the challenges, opportunities, and personal journeys along the way

results.title: Amazing Monster
results.original_title: アメイジング・モンスター
results.overview: Maria comes from a sacred family and wants to become a miko in her village of Appare. When a secret that has been kept hidden for 18 years is revealed, a mysterious power awakens within her.

results.title: The Modigliani Affair
results.overview: Livorno, summer 1984. Three sculpted heads emerge from the water. The art world hails them as authentic works by Modigliani. The only problem is: they are fakes. This is the incredible story of a hoax that spiraled out of control. The story of a fraud. The story of a death under circumstances that were never fully explained. One of the greatest art scandals of all time. One of the most intricate mysteries in the history of art—and, at the same time, a crystal-clear example of how a beautiful lie can always overpower, and be preferred to, any reality.

results.title: Doña Ninfa
results.overview: Jesús, a local young man, turns to Doña Ninfa to undergo a spiritual cleansing. Doña Ninfa is a fraudulent healer who performs rituals in a town that is itself alive a place that metes out justice against those who seek to profit through deception. During the ritual, the scene is terrorized by a light resembling a living entity that attempts to force its way into the house.

results.title: Lo Que Permanece
results.overview: Julián finds in Izel a close friend, someone who understands the pain of growing up in a home consumed by violence. In her, he finds the affection he cannot find in his brother. But he is unaware of the darkness some places carry, and of the truth behind the pain that haunts his nightmares.

results.title: Los Sagrados Alimentos
results.overview: Bernie de la Renta is an ordinary worker and family man who must make a great sacrifice to belong to a powerful sect.

results.title: Daphne as Woman (Crying)
results.overview: Daphne joins an audition hoping to revive her acting career. But when a casting assistant pushes her beyond reasonable limits, the session turns confessional, revealing ugly truths about the industry.

results.title: Adrift/A Rift
results.overview: An omniscient voice narrates the dissolution of a relationship against a montage of faceless malaise set in a beach resort.

results.title: Singaporeans at Gyeongbukgong Palace
results.overview: Standing at Gyeongbokgung Palace in Seoul, a filmmaker sardonically imagines the conversations of the crowd as if they were Singaporean.

results.title: The Host
results.overview: After checking into an Airbnb, Nick is warned never to open the door if someone rings the bell. When he ignores the warning, he encounters a terrifying entity, and becomes part of a cycle passed on to the next guest.

results.title: My Only Friend
results.overview: Lucas, a shy and introverted boy, is forced to interact with his classmates on a school project. He writes in his diary that Fernanda, his only friend, is the one who helps him get through a chaotic night.

results.title: The Mis-Summoning
results.overview: Lucy, a young college student who wants to speak with her late brother. When she tries to summon him back for one night, things don't go exactly how they plan to.

results.title: Tu Hai Meri Kiran
results.overview: What starts as a real connection for her turns into his all-consuming obsession. As love darkens, the boundary between devotion and danger fades.

results.title: If Ever
results.overview: When a long-anticipated wildfire approaches, a young girl struggles to say goodbye to the only home she’s ever known.
